items.title: Florian J. "Curly" Lizana Interview, 1966-05-18
items.q: He worked as a guy with one of his names. What was that real name? We used to call him Fort Bell.

ctx.x: I think A.J. LaCosta's retired. He doesn't know about Farrell.
There was also that blind man working at Whirlines. Yeah, that old blind guy.
